purpose: Materializes the operational closure of the Uellix/Stella Development Operating System v1. This artifact records an adjudication that was already independently established by the ODS-05-R2 final clean-room adversarial re-audit; it does not perform, re-perform, or re-adjudicate that audit.
scope_note: APPEND-ONLY EVIDENCE. This artifact creates no new authority, implements nothing, and remediates nothing. It does not rewrite, supersede, reinterpret or restate docs/ops/ods/ODS_V1_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json, docs/ops/ods/ODS_V1_EFFICIENCY_VALIDATION_v1.0.0.json, or any Wave 1 authority/evidence artifact. Those remain byte-identical and controlling. Where this artifact and any of them appear to disagree, they control.

anchors.note: The audited implementation HEAD/TREE above is the state the ODS-05-R2 audit measured and this closure certifies. This closure artifact is committed on top of it.

final_audit.supersedes_audit: ODS-05 (superseded: it discovered the CI history-prerequisite and prestate fail-closed defects, and its auditor mutated the audited worktree during attack construction)

authority_integrity_at_closure.non_circularity_basis: Corpus and authority-input integrity are closed against two external content-addressed Git anchors (the ODS-01 freeze commit and the certified Wave 1 commit). ODS-05-R2 demonstrated in disposable clones that a coordinated internally-consistent forgery, a rewrite of the authority artifact own records, and a committed forgery all still FAIL.

ci.no_hosted_run_claimed: No hosted GitHub Actions run was executed for this adjudication and none is claimed. Readiness was established by workflow inspection plus disposable full-history and depth-1 clone execution.
ci.history_prerequisite: actions/checkout@v4 with fetch-depth: 0 on the checkout preceding the authority gate.

NC1.subject: untracked directory collapsing in git status

NC2.subject: git mv destination assumption in rename handling

efficiency_and_routing.class_b_bound: CLASS_B_ROUTING=PASS records repository-outcome validation under the frozen authority own stated bar (model_executor_routing.classes.B.validation_requirement). It is NOT a claim of cryptographically proven model identity, and machine gates remain mandatory regardless of executor class.

bookkeeping.issue: The sibling CLIs do not apply the malformed trailing value-flag rejection that ODS-05-RM1 added to scripts/ods-prestate.ts.
bookkeeping.measured_behavior: Fail-closed in every malformed case (usage error or crash, always non-zero). A dropped --allow can only make the scope gate stricter, never authorize a path; the one PASS case is an empty diff, reported honestly as CHANGED_FILE_COUNT=0.

bookkeeping.issue: A duplicated value flag (for example --head A --head B) uses last-wins semantics without announcing it.
bookkeeping.measured_behavior: The assertion still executes and a mismatch still FAILS. Directionally opposite to the remediated ODS-05 defect, which dropped the assertion entirely.

bookkeeping.issue: The explanatory comment states a shallow-checkout failure would be indistinguishable in the log from real authority drift; measured, the error names the unreachable commit and path.
bookkeeping.measured_behavior: Prose only. The remediation the comment documents (fetch-depth: 0) is correct and unaffected.

wave1_carry_forward.rule: PRESERVED BY REFERENCE ONLY. This closure does not duplicate, re-scope, re-prioritize, remediate or re-adjudicate any Wave 1 carry-forward finding.

C2_GIT_ANCHOR_AVAILABILITY.constraint: ODS-C2 (authority:seal:verify) resolves historical blobs at two Git anchors. Both must remain available to CI: ff2ab23fbf2178a8b4930bd3943d3c53bc84a1dc (certified Wave 1 corpus anchor) and 2aecf625a49ec673fd4185052e71ec6e5c750edf (ODS authority freeze commit).
C2_GIT_ANCHOR_AVAILABILITY.why_it_holds_today: Both anchors are ancestors of every commit that carries the gate, so a full-history (fetch-depth: 0) checkout of any such commit reaches them.
C2_GIT_ANCHOR_AVAILABILITY.required_forward_handling: Before any future integration to main, preserve those objects through reachable remote history or a retained ref. Do NOT use a squash-and-delete workflow that would leave the required anchors unavailable, without first changing the authorized ODS-C2 design through an explicit authority update.
C2_GIT_ANCHOR_AVAILABILITY.prohibited_shortcut: Weakening, skipping or making optional the C2 anchor comparison in order to survive a history-losing merge strategy.
